<section  class='av_textblock_section av-k918740s-2acce2530b1d558a543400271be8facb '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><h2 style="text-align: center;">Salinas Bay</h2>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Our Kiteboarding school in Costa Rica is located in breathtaking Salinas Bay. One of the top kiteboarding beaches in Costa Rica (Central America), famous for its consistent strong winds which makes it perfect for kiteboarding.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">We commit to the highest teaching and safety standards in all our services. Including lessons, rentals, gear sales and instructor training courses. We have the most professional and experienced kiteboarding instructors in our kitesurfing school in Costa Rica, all IKO certified.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Costa Kite lessons are fun, safe and easy!</p>
<p>On the off season in Costa Rica, you can find us in our other kiteschool in Spain: <a href="http://www.cadizkite.com">www.cadizkite.com</a></p>
